title: Potion of Everlasting Vigour
summary: Drink to permanently increase Strength by 2.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, single use. Gain +2 Strength permanently, even above 20. It persists through death and respec. Applies after Ability Score Improvements but before capped bonuses. It does not add to an effect that sets Strength to a fixed score.
fields.Acquisition: Convince Astarion to bite Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
